offering_description.value: Veeco manufactures process equipment for integrated circuit, compound semiconductor, and wafer-level packaging producers. It supplies equipment and materials science expertise to companies, universities, and labs for work ranging from research to high-volume production.

quotes.quote: Veeco is an innovative manufacturer of semiconductor process equipment serving the IC, compound semi, and wafer-level packaging with a broad portfolio of products and comprehensive services.

Veeco's MEMS, material science and power management experts, helps customers make their mark on the future of smart cities, factories, and transportation systems. Veeco supports the transition from research to high-volume production by providing advanced tools and materials science expertise to support processes such as ALD, MBE, and IBS to universities, labs, and companies. Our technologies enable breakthroughs in semiconductors, optoelectronics, MEMS, and more—fueling innovation in 5G/6G, quantum computing, and IoT applications.

primary_products.value: laser annealing systems; thin-film deposition and etch systems; wafer cleaning systems; lithography systems; gas and vapor delivery systems

quotes.quote: Veeco is a leading innovator in semiconductor process equipment, offering advanced technologies such as laser annealing, ion beam deposition and etch, CVD, MOCVD, single wafer etch and clean, and lithography. Our solutions are engineered to enhance device performance, yield, and cost of ownership, securing Veeco’s position as a technology leader in the markets we serve.

Advanced semiconductor devices developed for the most leading-edge computing processes, such as AI and edge computing, need to be manufactured in ultra-high-purity environments. This is where material purity matters most, and where we can make a difference. Our gas and vapor delivery systems bring together the precise flow control, smart automation, and built-in diagnostics needed to help engineers maintain stability and repeatability.

primary_services.value: atomic layer deposition coating; deposition process consulting; precision dicing and lapping; tooling design

quotes.quote: Optimize your deposition process with our coating and consulting services. Our thin film coating services span a variety of materials to meet your needs.

We deliver tight tolerances and superior flatness when performing dicing and lapping processes. With over 30 years of experience in diversified dicing applications, Veeco provides a broad range of process and tooling design solutions that can improve production and result in higher throughput and quality.
